title: Samuel LLM ’55, SJD ’59 and Judith Pisar Visiting Professor of Law
bio: Philippe Sands KC is Professor of the Public Understanding of Law at University College London and Samuel and Judith Pisar Visiting Professor of Law at Harvard Law School. He is a practising barrister at 11 Kings Bench Walk, and frequently appears as counsel before the International Court of Justice and other international courts and tribunals. […]
